title: Subword Regularization: Improving Neural Network Translation Models with Multiple Subword Candidates

numbers.sentence: As common settings, we set the dropout probability to be 0.2.
Both length normalization and converge penalty parameters are set to 0.2 (see section 7 in ).

We evaluate three test systems with different sampling strategies: (1) Unigram language model-based subword segmentation without subword regularization ( ), (2) with subword regularization ) and (3) 0.2: IWSLT, 0.5: others.

We evaluate three test systems with different sampling strategies: (1) Unigram language model-based subword segmentation without subword regularization ( ), (2) with subword regularization ) and (3) 0.2: IWSLT, 0.5: others.
As German is a morphologically rich language and needs a huge vocabulary for word models, subword-based algorithms perform a gain of more than 1 BLEU point than word model.
Among subword-based algorithms, the unigram language model with subword regularization achieved the best BLEU score (25.04), which demonstrates the effectiveness of multiple subword segmentations.
